model.description: Sweetgrass Botanicals Honeydew 0.5g Rosin Cart delivers exceptional purity and potency in a convenient 510 thread cartridge. This premium rosin vape features solventless extraction that preserves the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes for an authentic, clean-hitting experience. The Honeydew strain offers a deliciously sweet melon flavor profile with refreshing fruity notes that delight the palate from first draw to last. Strain-specific and crafted from high-quality rosin, this cartridge provides smooth vapor and rich flavor without any additives or cutting agents. Perfect for cannabis connoisseurs seeking natural terpenes and full-bodied effects, this half-gram cart fits any standard 510 battery for ultimate portability. Sweetgrass Botanicals combines artisan extraction techniques with premium flower to create a vaping experience that's both flavorful and potent, making Honeydew an ideal choice for those who appreciate quality rosin cartridges.
